_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE engine knobs. core/decision.py reads stake_usd (capped at config/protected.json max_stake_usd) and min_net_edge (floored at engine.min_net_edge_floor). Everything else about whether and how to trade belongs to the engine (config/protected.json engine block, config/lanes.json). Change a knob only with settled evidence, and say why in notes.
notes: v4 (operator, 2026-09-26, Phil v2): flat $5; sizing waits until a lane has forward evidence (>= ~100 events before any fractional Kelly). min_net_edge 0.02 = the protected floor: edges are already net of taker fee and VWAP, and each lane's lambda already shrinks overconfident estimates toward the market. The v3 knobs (min_edge 0.04, per-edge-class floors, wide-book edge, category caps) were retired with the edge-class taxonomy; see git history.
